metadata.title: Quantum Parse Syntax Cipher Engine Methods
metadata.purpose: Engine-ready extraction of cipher, number, letter, symbol, syntax-digit, math-operation, homophone, and monad methods from the David-Wynn Miller Quantum Grammar library.
metadata.warning: This module preserves the document's internal method. It is not standard linguistics, mathematics, cryptography, or legal doctrine.

confirmed_items: The document contains a NUMBER-VALUE counting list: 0 through 9.
The document contains a LETTER-VALUES A-Z list.
The document contains a SYMBOLS list.
The document gives 4 + 4 x 4 = 20 as correct and 4 + 4 x 4 = 32 as wrong.
The document contains a FIRST-ORDER operation sequence: 1=multiply, 2=divide, 3=subtract, 4=add.
The document also contains a conventional-style operational order: parentheses, multiply, divide, subtract, addition, left-to-right.
The document defines MONAD as a sum and factor combination with cipher numbers.
The document defines NUMERICAL-CIPHER as using numbers with letters and words to complete thoughts and sentences.
The document uses syntax-role numbers, not merely A=1 through Z=26 gematria.
The document uses sound-alike/homophone math such as TO/TOO/FOR/FOUR/FORE/ATE.

corrections_or_gaps.issue: The uploaded OCR shows R,S,1,U,V..., but this is almost certainly OCR corruption of T.
corrections_or_gaps.engine_decision: Preserve raw OCR but normalize to T in the canonical alphabet.

corrections_or_gaps.issue: OCR contains duplicated or corrupted symbols such as X/Х, 1/I, brackets, and punctuation.
The document defines word-value/cipher conceptually but does not provide a complete deterministic A=1...Z=26 reduction recipe in the retrieved sections.
corrections_or_gaps.engine_decision: Implement as modular modes: syntax_digit_value, ordinal_letter_value, homophone_value, and symbolic_factor_value.

corrections_or_gaps.issue: MONAD is a conceptual sum/factor/whole-control method, not a closed equation.
corrections_or_gaps.engine_decision: Represent as an aggregation method rather than a fixed formula.

corrections_or_gaps.issue: The document gives both FIRST-ORDER operations and general operational math order.
corrections_or_gaps.engine_decision: Support two modes: syntax_first_order and standard_math_order.

ocr_notes.1_after_S: Interpreted as T because the list is otherwise A-Z.

letter_values.engine_role: optional ordinal mode; not the primary syntax-number method

symbol_roles./: division / and-marker in some word-claim sections
symbol_roles.\": quotation / void-writing in the wider rules

0.engine_meaning: neutral connector between nouns or clauses

1.engine_meaning: modifier, changing fact syntax, void fact, void contract, ailing word context/content

2.engine_meaning: action-word thinking syntax; correct-word-verb includes IS singular and ARE plural

3.engine_meaning: coloring syntax of facts; illusion/fiction; void/omit

4.engine_meaning: pronoun/no-no-no meaning; actor or assumption in fiction

5.engine_meaning: now-time rules, voting position, positional start of fact phrase

6.engine_meaning: original ownership / article position inside fact phrase

7.engine_meaning: now-time contract communication; fact/known; terminal noun component

numbering_code_terms.engine_use: A valid fact phrase is modeled as 5-6-7. Multiple fact phrases joined by a verb create reversible sentence structures.

example_forward.sentence: FOR THE TRUSTEE OF THE TRUST IS WITH THE AUTHORITY FOR THE WRITING OF THE CHECKS.

example_backward.sentence: FOR THE TRUST WITH THE AUTHORITY IS FOR THE WRITING OF THE CHECKS BY THE TRUSTEE.

reversibility_test.claim: Math can be proven forwards and backwards.
reversibility_test.engine_use: For transformed sentences, attempt forward/backward equivalence test where structure permits.

numerical_cipher.definition: Use numbers with letters and words with a completion of complete thoughts and complete sentences.
engine_implementation: assign syntax digit role to each token
optionally assign ordinal A-Z values to letters
evaluate sentence pattern for 5-6-7 fact phrases and action verb placement
return word-value as a structured object, not a single scalar unless a chosen mode requires it

word_value.definition: The document references word-value of each word, but retrieved sections do not give one closed scalar formula.
word_value.engine_decision: Represent word-value as a composite record: letters, ordinal values, syntax role, prefix/suffix status, homophones, and phrase role.

monad.definition: Sum and factor-combination with cipher-numbers with creation of a whole-control through a math-quantum.

homophone_math_methods.description: The document uses sound-alike or punning transformations as a math/cipher method. These should be separate from ordinal or syntax-digit arithmetic.

rules.notes: TO is also treated as future tense and void of now-time in other rules.

homophone_math_methods.engine_warning: Homophone math is not arithmetic. Treat it as a rewrite layer with confidence scores.

time_and_position_cipher_rules.engine_use: Reject or flag future/past/displaced terms when the phrase claims now-time contract jurisdiction.

directional_syntax.engine_use: Represent token dependencies as directed edges.

void_and_omission_symbols.DPV: dangling participial verb; void sentence ending syntax
void_and_omission_symbols.QUOTATION: void writing / omit content / void jurisdiction / opinion
void_and_omission_symbols.BRACKETS: closed-area void / omit area / court area
void_and_omission_symbols.NC: no-contract word; void word; negative; ailing; corrupt; fictitious; illusion; negative condition without performance

engine_pipeline.name: normalize_ocr
actions: normalize Cyrillic-looking X to x when used as multiplication
normalize OCR 1 after S in alphabet list to T
preserve raw tokens in audit trail
